items.title: منصرف - غير منصرف
items.description:
Detail the causes present in the following words by opting for ALL the possible causes applicable in the presented instance whilst considering the relationship of the causes.

If the word is Munsarif, tick "Munsarif" and continue to the next word.

If the word is Ghair Munsarif, tick "Ghair Munsarif" then tick all the applicable causes in the presented instance.

If the word is Munsarif & Ghair Munsarif, tick both "Munsarif" and "Ghair Munsarif" then tick all the applicable causes in the presented instance.
